membership.definition: Gross traded notional / same-day pretrade NAV. Entry/exit means actual quantity crosses zero. Target membership-change reasons are separate counts, not causal PnL attribution. Initial establishment excluded from the fraction.

modelRegime: Parent model schedules; X/n research variant; explicit monthly macro carry

strategyDefinition.description: Rolling one-year XGBoost, ETF activity and USD allocation. With fewer than four positive 252-session momentum qualifiers, retain only qualifying IEF, TLT and GLD incoming weights; hold the rest in cash and protect that budget through all later overlays.
strategyDefinition.name: Qualifying defensive ETFs + cash

researchVariant.overrides: Only selection top_n and target-adoption schedule; all eligibility/fallback/sizing contracts preserved

title: F3 · (X,n) = 8/0.10
warnings: Explicit operator-authorized monthly macro fallback; original vintage timestamps retained.
F3 retains legacy source-volume activity basis; cannot establish raw-activity transfer confirmation.
Retrospectively chosen strategies; walk-forward is not an untouched holdout.
Finite research only, no promotion or execution authority. X is a maximum, not a minimum allocation requirement.

The shared chart includes the 2020-12-31 initial cash anchor; grid CAGR and turnover annualize from the first evaluation session, 2021-01-04. This small calendar-convention difference does not change returns or decisions.

Decision flow: audited prices → unchanged eligibility and economic/momentum rank → top X → unchanged sizing/caps → L1 latest versus adopted target including cash → monthly or n crossing → next-open whole-unit accounting → hold shares.
The decision diagram and researchVariant field specify the executable X/n override.
